courses.title: Automotive Management Principles
courses.description: This course provides an overview of the various management positions in the automotive repair industry and an introduction to business planning and management methods. It is the entry point for students in the Baccalaureate degree program in Automotive Technology Management.

metadata.Limitation(s) on Enrollment - Other: Admission to the De Anza College Baccalaureate Degree Program in Automotive Technology Management.
metadata.Student Learning Outcomes: Determine the functions of running a business in the automotive repair industry, including inception, operations, management, marketing, accounting, and human resources.

courses.title: Automotive Planning and Small Business Management
courses.description: This course provides an understanding of employment practices and opportunities in automotive business management and ownership, including management principles, duties of a service manager, and financial operations of a service facility. The course will provide an understanding of owner communications, shop capacity management, leadership effectiveness, organizational behavior, and promotional strategies.

The course includes fleet utilization and replacement, human resources, parts management, safety requirements, and data services.

courses.title: Human Resources in the Automotive Industry
courses.description: This course is designed to analyze the problems, strategies, and procedures in managing and assessing human resources in automotive organizations. Special attention is given to problems in assessing abilities and performance, effective recruitment, selection and training, motivational strategies, and developing the organization’s human resources.

metadata.Limitation(s) on Enrollment - Other: Admission to the De Anza College Baccalaureate Degree Program in Automotive Technology Management.
metadata.Student Learning Outcomes: Determine the functions of human resources in the automotive repair industry and how they affect employee performance, satisfaction, and ethics.

courses.title: Automotive Sales, Finance, and Leasing
courses.description: This course is designed to familiarize the student with the basic economic principles that exist when a vehicle or other equipment is purchased or leased, viewed from a management perspective. Principals and problems are centered around the cost of capital, capital budgeting, and investment analysis. Also discussed are repayment schedules including amortized loans, refinancing, and variable rate loans.

metadata.Limitation(s) on Enrollment - Other: Admission to the De Anza College Baccalaureate Degree Program in Automotive Technology Management.
metadata.Student Learning Outcomes: Identify and describe the steps involved in managing the successful sales and financing of vehicles, accessories, and parts
